name: Movie trailer voice
about: A deep, dense, rumbling voice that sells the next big film, with a dark cinema-sized room behind it.

name: Epic trailer, cathedral boom
about: A giant low voice with an octave underneath, booming through stone and echoing back on the beat.

name: Horror trailer whisper
about: A breathy low narrator whose words are sucked in by backwards reverb before a cold, dark hall.

name: Documentary narrator
about: A calm, measured, warm narrator in a quiet hall, the voice of a serious film.

name: Nature documentary hush
about: A soft, breathy, close narrator speaking quietly so the birds in the wood are not disturbed.

name: Audiobook narrator warmth
about: A rich, smooth, gently levelled reading voice with soft s sounds, made for long listening.

name: True crime narrator
about: A low, close, serious storyteller in a small room, a mantel clock ticking somewhere behind.

name: Bedtime story by the fire
about: A slow, warm storyteller in the living room while a log fire crackles in the hearth.

name: Museum audio guide
about: A polished guide voice from the little handset you hold to your ear in a hushed gallery.

name: Planetarium dome narrator
about: A smooth voice floating under a huge dark dome, wide and slowly shimmering overhead.

name: Rallying speech on a battlefield
about: A commander's big, roughened call to the ranks, rolling back off the hills as the wind blows.

name: Trailer narration over a drone
about: A deep, slow trailer read with a dark drone underneath that swells up every time you speak.

name: Late-night radio host
about: The deep, smooth, close voice keeping you company on the radio after midnight.

name: Morning show DJ
about: A bright, punchy, wide-awake breakfast radio voice with a quick slap of echo.

name: Countdown show host
about: A loud, doubled chart-show voice with echoes bouncing in time with the music.

name: Slow jams night host
about: A velvet-low love songs host, softly shimmering, with a warm plate of reverb.

name: College radio, cheap studio
about: A student show from a boxy little room, the compressor pumping on every word.

name: Pirate radio station
about: A gritty, overdriven, squashed broadcast from an unlicensed transmitter, slightly off the dial.

name: Rock station jock
about: A loud, hot, tape-warmed rock radio voice with a quick slap of tape echo.

name: Overnight jazz host
about: An unhurried, mellow, slightly dark voice from a small club-like studio in the small hours.

name: Talk radio host
about: A booming, opinionated, tightly squeezed voice right up on the microphone.

name: Caller on the talk show
about: A listener phoning in from a mobile, squeezed through the station's processing on air.

name: Station ID with a swoosh
about: A punchy station name read through a jet-like swoosh, echoes flying from ear to ear.

name: Podcast intro over music
about: A polished podcast host over a warm music pad that dips under your words and rises in the pauses.

name: Evening news anchor
about: A clear, steady, trustworthy voice reading the headlines from a quiet studio desk.

name: Breaking news bulletin
about: An urgent, faster, hard-edged newsreader cutting into the programme.

name: Reporter in the wind
about: A field reporter on a windscreened mic, gusts tearing past while you keep talking.

name: Reporter in the pouring rain
about: Live on location in a downpour, rain hammering the pavement around the microphone.

name: Live from a busy street
about: A reporter on the sidewalk downtown, traffic swishing by and horns going off.

name: Satellite link from overseas
about: A far-away correspondent on a thin digital link, a faint echo of the line coming back late.

name: Correspondent on a satellite phone
about: A crackling, breaking satellite phone line from a far place, thunder rolling in the distance.

name: Traffic report from the helicopter
about: The traffic reporter on a headset mic, the rotor thumping through every word.

name: Press conference podium
about: A statement read at a podium mic, bouncing round a bare briefing room.

name: Podium speech, big hall
about: A formal address at a podium, the speech rolling round a huge hall to a hushed audience.

name: Election night newsroom
about: A results anchor over a buzzing newsroom: phones ringing, keyboards rattling, producers talking.

name: Weather radio monotone
about: A flat, almost machine-like forecast voice on a tinny all-weather radio.

name: Emergency alert broadcast
about: A harsh, squeezed, tinny warning that takes over every radio station at once.

name: Civil defense loudspeaker
about: A siren whoop, then a warning from a rooftop horn echoing across the whole town.

name: Tornado warning on the radio
about: A crackling, fading warning on the car radio while the storm rolls in overhead.

name: Police loudspeaker
about: A siren yelp and a squealing bullhorn order on a busy street.

name: Wartime air raid warning
about: A siren wail and a warning from the rooftop horns, heard on a crackling archive record.

name: Beach warning from the lifeguard tower
about: A bullhorn warning shouted down the beach from the tower, surf crashing all along the shore.

name: Stairwell evacuation message
about: Three chimes and a calm recorded order to leave, echoing down a bare concrete stairwell.

name: Hand-crank radio in the storm cellar
about: A warning crackling from a little wind-up radio down in the cellar while the wind howls overhead.

name: Highway advisory radio loop
about: A flat, looping roadside info message at the bottom of the car radio dial, tyres humming along.

name: Play-by-play from the booth
about: A sports caller on a headset in the press box, the crowd roaring through the glass.

name: Stadium PA announcer
about: Your voice over the big horns of a stadium, echoing off the far stands above the crowd.

name: Boxing ring announcer
about: A huge, drawn-out introduction from the middle of the ring, the arena going wild.

name: Horse race caller
about: A rapid-fire race call through the grandstand horns, the crowd rising at the finish.

name: Golf commentator hush
about: A slow, murmured, close commentary on a sunny course, insects and birds all around.

name: Basketball arena announcer
about: A ringing arena PA introducing the home team, the hard court slapping your voice back.

name: Wrestling ring announcer
about: An over-the-top, red-hot introduction in a roaring arena, echoing out over the chants.

name: Ballpark announcer, summer evening
about: The ballpark PA from far up the stands, delayed echoes drifting over a lazy crowd.

name: Post-game interview
about: A pitchside interview on a handheld mic with the celebrating crowd right behind you.

name: Ballgame on a transistor radio
about: The play-by-play crackling out of a little pocket radio on a hot summer afternoon.

name: Airport gate announcement
about: A two-note chime, then your voice from the ceiling speakers of a busy terminal.

name: Train station platform
about: Three chimes and a platform announcement echoing off the tiles as a train rumbles in.

name: Shopping mall PA
about: A friendly chime and a ceiling-speaker announcement over the food court chatter.

name: School principal on the intercom
about: The morning announcements from the classroom speaker box, lockers banging in the hall.

name: Hospital overhead page
about: A calm page from a small ceiling speaker down a long ward corridor, monitors beeping.

name: Supermarket staff call
about: A tinny, pushed staff call from the store ceiling, freezers humming down the aisle.

name: Cruise ship deck announcement
about: A loudspeaker on the open deck, gulls calling and a foghorn sounding across the harbor.

name: Ride operator spiel
about: The quick, crackly safety speech from a ride's speaker box at the fairground.

name: Drive-in movie speaker
about: The rattling little speaker hung on your car window, crickets singing in the dark lot.

name: Factory floor announcement
about: A pushed, ringing PA horn fighting the presses and conveyors on a factory floor.

name: Parking garage PA
about: A ceiling speaker announcement smeared across the bare concrete of a parking garage.

name: Church hall bingo caller
about: Numbers called on a cheap mic through the hall speakers, cups and chatter at the tables.

name: Lifeguard at the pool
about: A bullhorn warning bouncing round a tiled indoor swimming pool.

name: Town crier in the square
about: A bellowing proclamation read slowly to the market square, bouncing off the old stone fronts.

name: Tour bus guide
about: A cheerful guide on the coach's crackly handheld mic, the diesel rumbling along under you.

name: Game show host
about: A bright, beaming host on a studio stage, the audience buzzing in their seats.

name: Lightning round quiz
about: A quizmaster racing through the questions, tight, wide and punchy.

name: Livestock auctioneer
about: A lightning-fast auction chant through a horn speaker in a big wooden sale barn.

name: Casino lounge host
about: A smooth lounge host on the casino floor mic, slot machines chiming all around.

name: Award show announcer
about: The voice of the evening filling a grand concert hall, applause settling in the dark.

name: Ringmaster under the big top
about: A grand, low ringmaster through a horn, ringing round a huge tent while the band plays.

name: Carnival barker
about: A fast-talking barker on a megaphone calling the crowd over to the games.

name: Children's TV presenter
about: A bouncy, bright, extra-friendly kids' show host in a colourful little studio.

name: Cooking show in a busy kitchen
about: A chef host talking you through it on a clip-on mic while pans sizzle and pots clang.

name: Commercial smile read
about: A bright, buoyant advert voice that sounds like it is smiling on every word.

name: Shouty weekend sale ad
about: A fast, overdriven, wall-to-wall loud sale advert with echoes flying out of it.

name: Late-night infomercial pitch
about: An eager, quick pitch on the living room TV for something you never knew you needed.

name: Fast fine-print disclaimer
about: The small print at the end of an advert, read at almost double speed.

name: On-hold message
about: A polished recorded message squeezed down a modern phone line while you wait.

name: Guided meditation voice
about: A slow, soft, warm guide in a spacious calm room, waves rolling in far away.

name: Cinema preshow announcement
about: The please-silence-your-phones voice filling a wide cinema from every speaker.

name: Battle arena announcer
about: A huge, growling video game announcer with a burst of gated room on every word.

name: 1930s radio drama
about: An actor on a theatre stage, heard through a crackling wooden radio set from the 1930s.

name: Wartime radio bulletin
about: A grave news bulletin from across the sea, fading in and out on the shortwave.

name: 1940s newsreel
about: A brisk, punchy, honking narrator on a crackling old cinema soundtrack.

name: 1950s TV announcer
about: A smart announcer from the tiny speaker of a 1950s television set, humming in the room.

name: 1960s pop radio jingle
about: A peppy, squashed AM pop station voice with a splash of studio echo.

name: 1970s FM underground DJ
about: A mellow, warm, slightly swirling free-form FM voice from a smoky late studio.

name: 1980s FM commercial
about: A bright, dense, chorused advert voice with a burst of gated room and wide stereo.

name: Radio serial cliffhanger
about: A dramatic old radio serial with a twangy spring reverb on every line.

name: Early TV test broadcast
about: An announcer on an early television in the next room, the screen hissing with snow.

name: Radio set by the fireplace
about: An old wireless across the living room, the fire crackling beside you as you listen.

name: Moon broadcast on the family TV
about: Mission voices and their beeps, crackling all the way from the moon onto an old living room TV.
